---

Each archive is a zstd-compressed srcML XML archive. To use one:

```sh
gh release download <tag> --repo mikeweyandt/srcMLSystemArchive --pattern '*.xml.zst'
zstd -d <tag>.xml.zst
```

Every release also carries a `.manifest.json` recording the exact commit, srcml flags, sha256, and per-language unit counts.
